thesis: Pactway improves real-world UX by combining current business web surfaces with frontier-model intent, explanation, approval, routing, and memory.

surfaces.label: Pactway approval, routing, and memory layer
Existing business system of record
owns: payment or order records where applicable

surfaces.label: Owner review packet in frontier or web UI

journeys.goal: Ask an assistant to coordinate a real-world request without browsing and guessing.

steps.uxJob: Clarify the customer need, timing, constraints, and preferred outcome.
steps.pactwayBoundary: No action has happened yet; the model only drafts intent.

steps.uxJob: Show whether the business can answer, request, book, submit, manage, or hand off.
steps.pactwayBoundary: Capability is derived from owner-approved facts and backend proof, never inferred from model confidence.

steps.uxJob: Ask the user to approve the exact scoped action and visible constraints.
steps.pactwayBoundary: Approval must be explicit before state-changing or commitment-adjacent actions.

steps.uxJob: Route the approved request to the verified destination or downgrade to handoff.
steps.pactwayBoundary: Pactway routes and records; it does not claim backend confirmation without backend proof.

steps.uxJob: Restore status and receipt refs when the user returns in a later frontier session.
steps.pactwayBoundary: The frontier model receives a model-safe status summary and must not invent lifecycle state.

journeys.goal: Start from the business website but get frontier-model help without making the business rebuild its site.

steps.uxJob: Use the business website for brand, policy, menu, service, and visual context.
steps.pactwayBoundary: Website facts are context until owner-approved and verified through Pactway.

steps.uxJob: Clarify what the customer wants to do with the business context already visible.
steps.pactwayBoundary: The assistant cannot treat page text as authority for action.

steps.uxJob: Create the same authorized experience object used by frontier-start flows.
steps.pactwayBoundary: Starting from the webpage does not bypass exact approval, route verification, or receipt memory.

journeys.goal: Make the current website and business channels AI-experience-ready with minimal owner work.

steps.uxJob: Approve, edit, or defer the few facts and action boundaries that affect customer experience.
steps.pactwayBoundary: Candidate facts are not publishable truth until owner-reviewed.

steps.uxJob: Verify business ownership and destination control before making the port actionable.
steps.pactwayBoundary: Verification is earned, never self-asserted by the owner packet.

steps.uxJob: Receive requests, bookings, or handoffs through existing tools.
steps.pactwayBoundary: The business system keeps fulfillment truth; Pactway records receipts and status refs.

blockedClaims: Frontier model memory is lifecycle authority.
A ticket is limited to service-business booking.
Pactway owns the booking, payment, support, POS, or CRM system of record.
Pactway guarantees ranking, traffic, or AI citation.
